'''Ken''' (Japanese: '''ケン''' ''Ken'') is a character who appears in [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]]. He is one of [[Shu]]'s many [[rival]]s.

==History==
Shu meets Ken for the first time in ''[[GDZ16|Battle in the Smokescreen]]''. Though Shu had never met Ken before, Ken knew exactly who he was and claims that Shu is very famous among Pokémon Trainers. Shu challenges Ken to a battle and eventually defeats him. As a prize for winning, Ken gives Shu a guitar which he autographed, claiming that it is a very valuable item. Unknown to Ken, Shu finds the item totally useless.
